requestedActions.title: Read titles and content of Notion pages that each customer explicitly shares with the integration

guide.summary: The confirmed request is a customer-facing web app that reads titles and content of Notion pages each customer explicitly shares with the integration, with no writes or workspace administration. Notion documents OAuth integrations for per-user authorization, where each user authorizes the app and selects pages via a page picker, and capabilities control access, with Read content being the relevant capability for retrieving page content. Authorization can start once client credentials and redirect URI are configured without Marketplace review. Distribution to other customer workspaces remains unresolved.
guide.recommendation: The requested API test is not ready yet. Resolve the access mapping for Read titles and content of Notion pages that each customer explicitly shares with the integration. Use “Find missing request” or add official documentation beside that action.

findings.title: OAuth integration authorization flow for per-user access
findings.detail: Notion documents OAuth integrations for apps that act on behalf of each user; each user authorizes separately, selects pages via the page picker, and the app exchanges the code for a user-tied access token. Authorization can start once client credentials and redirect URI are configured; Marketplace review is not required.
findings.appliesWhen: Customers connect their own Notion accounts to the app and share specific pages with it.

findings.title: Read content capability for reading page titles and content
findings.detail: The Read content capability lets a connection read existing content; a connection with only this capability can call Retrieve endpoints. Retrieving page markdown requires read content capabilities on the target page. Read content does not permit updates or page creation.
findings.appliesWhen: The app only reads shared page titles and content; no create, update, or administration.

steps.title: Create the OAuth integration and configure credentials and redirect URI
steps.detail: In the Notion Developer portal, open Build > Connections and create a new connection with a name, development workspace, redirect URI, and installation scope. Choose Read content only in capabilities. From the Configuration tab, record the OAuth client ID and client secret and store them in environment variables, never in source code. Authorization can start once these are configured; Marketplace review is not required. The authorization URL in the Configuration tab is used in the next step.
steps.doneWhen: Connection exists with redirect URI, Read content capability only, and client ID and secret stored outside source control.
